# Dodge Charger Police NYPD

Model by [David_Holiday](https://sketchfab.com/David_Holiday).
Original work: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dodge-charger-police-nypd-578e2bfb9c8f415d932527a938e2fc64
License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Primary Sketchfab API verified downloadable with license `by` on 23 October 2026; see `police-source.json`.

Downloaded from the licensed [carros redistribution](https://github.com/pedrosoandre/carros) ([source manifest](https://github.com/pedrosoandre/carros/blob/main/cars.json), [provenance](https://github.com/pedrosoandre/carros/blob/main/LICENSE-3D-MODELS.md)) as `dodge-charger-police.glb`, shipped here as `police-david-holiday.glb` (SHA-256 a08389c3...f35). That redistribution applies weld, simplification, prune, and Meshopt compression. Game adaptations: scaled to 4.7 m length and rotated in the game loader; the roof lenses share the game's flashing red/blue materials. No new car model was generated. Brand and department names identify the model subject and imply no endorsement.

Downloaded derivative triangles: 16,542
Required glTF extensions: EXT_meshopt_compression, KHR_mesh_quantization
